hypothesis: For the exact Clark-Hash candidate selected by the frozen Qwen3.8-27B real-weight gate, a separately versioned native AVX2 kernel can execute the packed INT4 A(Rx) correction on every layer-0 MLP projection shape with no more than 5e-4 arithmetic disagreement and at least 1.10x median coefficient-GEMV speedup over its scalar C oracle while retaining the parent's at-most-1.57 projected component bits per weight

scope.claim_boundary: native correction microkernel only; not a complete layer, model, quality, storage, throughput, semi-lossless, or breakthrough result

parent.candidate_selection: use exactly gate.selected_candidate from the authenticated parent; no alternate candidate or dimension may be timed

representation.formula: W approximately equals T plus A R
representation.runtime: compute R x once then add packed INT4 A times R x directly to the ternary output
representation.projection_mapping: uint16 buckets and signed int8 signs regenerated at load time from the parent seed; excluded from canonical model storage and counted as active compute metadata
representation.coefficient_codes: signed two's-complement INT4 -7 through 7, two row-aligned nibbles per byte; nibble 8 and a nonzero odd tail nibble are invalid
representation.coefficient_scales: one little-endian FP16 scale per output row
representation.accumulation: FP32; AVX2/FMA accumulates two eight-lane vectors, reduces each with the frozen pairwise horizontal order, then handles the scalar tail
representation.gate_up_reuse: one projected activation must be reused for both gate and up coefficient GEMVs

measurement.full_shape_coefficients: deterministic synthetic signed INT4 values and FP16 scales; dimensions come exclusively from the selected real-weight parent candidate
measurement.compiler: system C compiler with C11 O3 Wall Wextra Werror shared PIC and mtune=native
measurement.isa: AVX2 plus FMA required and authenticated by the native library
measurement.threading: single process and one pinned physical CPU; kernel itself is single-threaded
correctness: safe scalar projection equals the deterministic Clark Hash algebra
safe AVX2 coefficient GEMV is compared with the scalar C oracle
combined projection-plus-GEMV equals separate native calls
in-place correction addition equals base output plus the separate correction
gate and up projection metadata are byte-identical and a shared-projection timing is recorded
